name: Missing Data Map
description: Creates a labeled missing-data heatmap with deterministic observation sampling.

variables_axis.title: Variables axis
variables_axis.description: Axis whose positions are treated as variables; all remaining axes are flattened into observations.

variable_count.title: Variable count
variable_count.description: 0 selects all variables from variable_start; positive values select a contiguous range.

max_variables.title: Maximum variables
max_variables.description: Safety budget for the variable axis.

max_observations.title: Maximum observations
max_observations.description: 0 renders every observation; positive values request deterministic observation sampling.
